review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and independent AI peer review); no native-speaker signoff
review: Make Masks flagged and required mask layers (2026-10-26): per-layer Flag and Require objects check boxes in the Mask layers category, the Show only flagged switch, the any/every match mode for required layers, the matching-image count, the flagged Pick status line and the Merge visible layers button with its status lines. Terminology follows the existing Mask layers, Pick (Choose), Keep, Previous and Next reviews; placeholders {id}, {total}, {checked}, {matched}, {count} and {layers} are preserved exactly.

records.key: Draw only the flagged layers, and fill only the curated objects that overlap a flagged object or that you edited on this field. Hidden objects are saved unchanged. Pick: click a flagged object to remove the curated object under it, again to restore it; a flagged object over background is added.
records.source: Draw only the flagged layers, and fill only the curated objects that overlap a flagged object or that you edited on this field. Hidden objects are saved unchanged. Pick: click a flagged object to remove the curated object under it, again to restore it; a flagged object over background is added.
records.translation: Rita bara de flaggade lagren, och fyll bara de kurerade objekt som överlappar ett flaggat objekt eller som du har redigerat i det här synfältet. Dolda objekt sparas oförändrade. Välj: klicka på ett flaggat objekt för att ta bort det kurerade objektet under det, och en gång till för att återställa det; ett flaggat objekt över bakgrund läggs till.

records.key: Removed object {id}; click the flagged outline again to restore it.
records.source: Removed object {id}; click the flagged outline again to restore it.
records.translation: Tog bort objekt {id}; klicka på den flaggade konturen igen för att återställa det.

records.key: This layer's objects are problems to review: with Show only flagged on, only they and the curated objects they overlap are drawn.
records.source: This layer's objects are problems to review: with Show only flagged on, only they and the curated objects they overlap are drawn.
records.translation: Det här lagrets objekt är problem att granska: när Visa bara flaggade är på ritas bara de och de kurerade objekt som de överlappar.

records.key: Visit only images where this layer has at least one object.
records.source: Visit only images where this layer has at least one object.
records.translation: Besök bara bilder där det här lagret har minst ett objekt.

records.key: Which images Previous, Next and Keep visit: those where any required layer has an object, or those where every required layer has one. With no layer required, every image is shown.
records.source: Which images Previous, Next and Keep visit: those where any required layer has an object, or those where every required layer has one. With no layer required, every image is shown.
records.translation: Vilka bilder Föregående, Nästa och Behåll besöker: de där något obligatoriskt lager har ett objekt, eller de där varje obligatoriskt lager har ett. Om inget lager är obligatoriskt visas alla bilder.

records.key: Add every object of the visible layers, other than the base, to the curated overlay of this image, each with a new id. Where objects overlap, the curated overlay keeps its pixels and an added object fills only background, as Pick does. With Show only flagged on, only flagged layers are merged. One undo step.
records.source: Add every object of the visible layers, other than the base, to the curated overlay of this image, each with a new id. Where objects overlap, the curated overlay keeps its pixels and an added object fills only background, as Pick does. With Show only flagged on, only flagged layers are merged. One undo step.
records.translation: Lägg till varje objekt i de synliga lagren, utom baslagret, i bildens kurerade överlägg, vart och ett med ett nytt id. Där objekt överlappar behåller det kurerade överlägget sina pixlar och ett tillagt objekt fyller bara bakgrund, som Välj gör. När Visa bara flaggade är på slås bara flaggade lager samman. Ett ångrasteg.

records.key: Nothing to merge: the visible layers have no object over background.
records.source: Nothing to merge: the visible layers have no object over background.
records.translation: Inget att slå samman: de synliga lagren har inget objekt över bakgrund.
